body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Native Union introduced the Pop Phones, the latest innovation in Native Union's expanding Moshi Moshi line, which provides a range of functional and design-focused mobile device handsets created to give consumers an entirely new mobile talking experience.

The new line of Pop Phones is a bright and vibrant take on the already-popular MM01H Retro handset, which combines classic style with a contemporary edge as envisioned by acclaimed French designer David Turpin. Available in a rainbow of colors that "pop," including pink, yellow, dark purple, dark blue and green, the Pop Phones feature a high quality speaker and microphone, and can be used with all mobile phones, when fitted with the correct adapter. When paired with a USB adaptor, the handset can be used for VOIP computer telephone calls (Skype, Google Talk, etc.). The handset, fitted with a 3.5 mm jack, also turns an iPad into a telephone.
The Pop Phone line is equipped with the following features:
• The 3.5mm jack plugs directly into the iPhone, Blackberry and the latest Macbooks
• One touch button for pick-up/hang-up directly from the handset
In addition to functional benefits, the POP Phone also delivers compelling health benefits to consumers

when used as a telephone handset, as each dramatically reduces exposure to the radiation emitted by mobile devices, which is linked to an increased risk of cancer. Medical research indicates that heavy, direct-to-ear cell phone usage can potentially cause health damage and Native Union has addressed these concerns by reducing cell phone radiation from mobile phones through the use of its speakers and handsets. Independent testing Native Union Debuts Two New Lines at Pepcom by TUV, the world's leading certification company, found that Native Union's handsets reduce radiation by 99.5 percent.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
